notes: Brunei levies NO VAT, GST or general sales tax (MoFE Revenue Division administers only income tax, petroleum income tax and stamp duty) - VAT fields null for gold and silver. Customs import duty on HS 7108 is Nil (BDTTC). Note: a separate 15% EXCISE duty applies to Chapter 71 goods on import (BDTTC 2022) - an excise, not import duty or VAT, so not coded in the duty field.
